title: Python Foundations Technical State and Syntax Ledger

indentation_error.cause: Mixing tabs and spaces or inconsistent indentation levels
indentation_error.remedy: Standardize on 4 spaces per block level

type_error_concatenation.cause: Attempting to concatenate str and int with plus operator
type_error_concatenation.symptom: TypeError: can only concatenate str (not 'int') to str
type_error_concatenation.remedy: Use f-strings or explicit str() conversion
